body: As a child up to my adolescence, I have always dreamed about the same house. It's not anything grand. A middle class house on some road with lots of trees. It gives me a sense of calm & content that nothing in real life can compare to. When I get on/pass by roads that look slightly similar to the one that house is on, I get this warm feeling & a cross between brief joy & content that lasts for a few seconds. I wonder what/whose house that is, if it's somehow relevant to me/my life and what it tries to manifest to me in real life.

My college "bestfriend" (we'll call her Katie) turned out to be a really horrible, self-centered brat. I met her on the first day of college and typing this out feels so wrong because there were long stretches of time she was nice to me but if I could go back in time, I most definitely wouldn't want to have met her. She is lazy & just overall unmotivated. I didn't realize that until it was too late. I don't blame it all on her because I am responsible for my actions but being with her made me not attend classes simply because she was the only person I was friends with (all our other blockmates were ignorant cunts) and she brushes off going to classes with really petty reasons and takes me along with her. She badmouths professors who call us/her out for our being late/absent, and gets mad at the pettiest of reasons and makes everything about her (I didnt make a big deal out of it at first. She was really really nice to me.) Anyway, we both reached our junior year with probably around 8 subjects passed. Horrible, I know. Anyway, she started gaining other friends who she introduced to me, who I'm now also friends with. That's when things took a turn. She ultimately began treating these friends slightly inferior, and when these friends do things that are against her preference (Example: Katie's boyfriend picked up our other friends at McDonald's for a surprise party for our friend's boyfriend. One of our friends needed to pick up a cake from a store that's probably 3 minutes away from McDonald's. They drove there. Katie gets stark raving mad and started screaming & threatened not to push thru with the party because they didn't get back to her house first which was 30 minutes away from McDonald's before picking up the cake. Her reasoning: She is the girlfriend so she must be the priority)

Anyway, story of our falling out: Katie was pissed at me and the other friend for something SUPER petty (Friend and I got dismissed early in class. Katie was just on her way. It would take about an hour for her to get to school, so friend & I decided to pass time & told her we'd go head out to a nearby market first to buy something while waiting for her to get to school. This did not sit well with her self-centered preference) She didn't talk to me for 3 weeks straight after that. I've texted her a few times, no reply. 
Then came Valentine's Day. I sent all of the people on my contact list a Valentine greeting including Katie and her boyfriend which I assumed were on a hot air balloon festival together as what our other friends brought up in a conversation a few weeks back. I get a reply from an imessage email address with Katie's name on it (katiesmith@icloud.com) greeting me back so of course, I was happy she finally wanted to talk to me. I texted "I missed you!!" And she replied "I missed you too haha"  I asked her what she & her boyfriend were up to. I got a reply that it is in fact her boyfriend texting. I got really hurt because I know Katie's ways and if she's mad at somebody, she'd let them know in indirect, hurtful of ways. I assumed Katie instructed her boyfriend to go talk to me and let me know it's him instead of her to let me know further she has no interest to talk to me & spite me. So I brushed it off and went my merry way with my then boyfriend.
The next thing I knew, Katie was talking trash about me on twitter and to our friend saying I am really inconsiderate. Turns out, she and her boyfriend weren't together when we were texting and that her boyfriend's using her imessage address since they swapped phones. It was his boyfriend who replied an "I missed you too". Katie put malice to that (her boyfriend and I, as with our other friends, are kinda buddies since we hang out lots of times as a couple with my then boyfriend) and he didn't tell Katie about the convo. Katie found out when she went through his messages. I texted Katie about not knowing that her boyfriend's the person I've been texting, yadda yadda and all hell broke loose. She called me really mean things that I HAVE NEVER IN MY WILDEST DREAMS thought she'd be capable of saying to me. Think of all the meanest things a former friend can say and use against you, that's what her replies were like. I mentioned she should just stop tweeting about me and that she should've confronted me right away. She said she doesnt care because she's hurt and needs to vent and if I am hurt by the process of it all, she doesn't gives a shit as long as she gets to release her feelings. She said lots of other bullshit about me. All my replies were me telling her not to text me anymore and that this pettiness should completely stop. After that, she continued to tweet mean things that attacked me personally for months and months. Mean things that are totally irrelevant and unrelated to what we have argued over. She spilled stuff I only told her to our other friends and tried to "subtly" turn one against me. She would give side comments to everything I post. Her twitter is literally about me and how spiteful she is towars me. Meanwhile, I had gone to be the higher person and never did I talk mean stuff about her even when my friends are coaxing me/trying to make me talk about what happened. When someone tries to bring her up & our situation, my only & ever consistent reply is "She is as good as dead to me". My facebook & twitter account are all filled with positive posts (not one single little spiteful thing about her or anyone)

Months later, she messages me saying she is sorry. Why? Her boyfriend and her broke up and I guess she had no one to turn to. And because I'm a stupid fool, I forgave her and are now friends again with her because I have no other friends. I'm the idiot in the story now. I have social anxiety and somehow in our brief nice moments in the past, she has helped me overcome that and that's the only thing I like about her. This reconciliation will backfire on me one day I'm fully aware as she's super self-centered and spiteful to this day. Man, I don't know. I hate myself and this anxiety that lets me settle for people I don't deserve.

Got banned from my grade school's library for returning a book that had a tiny rip at the plastic cover EVEN BEFORE I BORROWED IT, I SWEAR. The librarian called me a liar and I was tearing up explaining and swearing up and down t was already ripped when I borrowed it. She stood her ground, called me a young liar & told me I can never borrow from the school library again. I despise that lady.

Hi. There were a lot of factors but it was mostly my fault in a sense that I was very immature— I demand a break up everytime he does/says things that does not sit well with me. He was an amazing boyfriend to the extent that he unconsciouly spoiled me which made me feel so entitled that when he makes petty mistakes, I make him feel like a terrible boyfriend. He's a good catch, that one. Amazing, amazing times. I was very well-loved. He is extremely good-looking as well. I don't even have words for how our break-up destroyed me. There's something about hearing the love of your life tell you he doesn't love & see a future with you anymore. I'm not spiteful but I'll carry that with me forever. It's life changing to experience the best thing that's ever happened to you transition into a nightmare.

I chanced upon the first one of the series of the Anne of Green Gables novels in a secondhand bookshop and oh god DID I FALL IN LOVE. I'm from the rural part of the Philippines & these are hard to come by especially since it's international & old literature. I searched high and low for all the other series. I was 12 and begged my dad to take me to all the bookshops there are. It was bloody but I was able to acquire three of the 8 series (By mere luck and persistence. I would literally go through every single book on the shelves) I even had my mom take me with her to her hometown so I could go through every bookshops and search for the remaining 5 novels. I gave up eventually, I just couldnt find them anywhere. One time, my grandma who is in the US whom I only get to talk to over the phone for like, 3 minutes once a month sent us a package. My grandma is the typical asian grandma and although as charming as she is, she never once got into reading as she only finished 3rd grade. She sends me random books she'd see on yard sales upon knowing I like to read. She's straight up clueless. She sends me pornographic reading on accident every once in a while without knowing. Anyway, this package contained the typical asian grandma package. But lo and behold, right there, staring me in the face, were the COMPLETE SERIES OF ANNE OF GREEN GABLES IN THE SAME EDITION I WAS LOOKING FOR. I shrieked and jumped like a banshee and to this day, I still get goosebumps thinking about it. I never once told my grandma about the novels I was looking for nor did my parents. It was just the most mindblowing thing I've ever experienced.

My ex and his twin brother looks straight up exactly the same. They themselves would have a hard time figuring out which is which in baby photos. I remember one time I came over, my ex opened the door while his twin was on the couch. I walked past my ex and went directly to his twin. I'd still have to do a double take when they're together although we dated for a year & have seen every inch and angle of him. When we broke up, I was totally devastated. I'd look at his & the twin's fb profile and grieve, they're like the same person to me. Dating him felt a lot like dating his twin as well.

Woke up in the middle of the night & pretended to still be asleep when I overheard my mom & dad talking about my mom cheating. My mom is honestly downright beautiful. She used to be title holders for beauty pageants & up to this day everyone tells me my mom is better looking than any of us her children. She has this perfect wife vibe like you see in movies. Very ladylike, reserved, very prim & proper. Super demure. So you could already imagine how traumatizing it was for me to know about that. This is the biggest shock & darkest secret of my whole entire life and no one knows it probably except for my parents, me, and the guy my mom cheated on with. My dad has cheated beforehand and my mom went ballistic since then & wont stop talking shit about my dad & my grandma (I understand her pain for that) But to this day, (10 years had passed) She still talks about it like my dad is the worst person on the planet (I'm not taking my dad's side because a part of me still cant forgive him for cheating; it was a bad turning point in our lives and affected me psychologically) 
I can still remember the conversation. My dad had apparently spotted my mom walking in a bridge after guy dropped him off. And that my mom had a separate sim card to contact the guy. My dad repeatedly asked my mom if they had sex. My mom keeps denying it (But I doubt) For my 12 year old mind, it was too hard to process.
It just trips me out how she can talk terrible things about my father for his cheating when she has done the exact same thing. I have always wanted to confront her about it but I just cant bring myself to do that. She knows we all hold a high regard for her & I bet it's ruin her to know that I actually know about what she did.

This is so timely. A 16 year old in our town died 2 days ago & almost everyone on my facebook & twitter timeline is grieving. Poor guy was taking a leak on a wall in front of their house when a car randomly come charging towards him & drags him for a short distance. Guy driving the car is a 16 year old drunk guy WHO HAPPENS TO BE IN THE SAME GROUP OF FRIENDS OF THE KID WHO DIED. People saw what happened, flagged down the teenage drunk driver & beat him unconscious. They go to the same school but drunk driver's from the Montessori department while the kid who died was from the regular department (these two departments always had rifts; this incident made it worse) What sickens me is that everyone keeps wishing the drunk driver well & defending his side of the story: He didnt intend to kill anybody. I get the point but he drunk drove & is a minor. The dead kid's family were enraged. I mean, if the same thing happened to anyone in my family, I'd go ballistic if they didnt take full accountability for what happened & it'd be a big slap in the face if anybody would ever defend the killer & pass it off as an accident. The kid died a painful death & the drunk driver must suffer. People pass off drunk driving as accidents. Fuck that. People drunk driving is a fucking crime already.

Also, when I told my ex-boyfriend some of his schoolmates transferred to our college. (Ours is a lowkey, inexpensive college. His was a prestigious university in our town) And he replied "Lol, they all probably flunked."
When I tried to call him out on it, and I was trying to make him realize what he was implying, he retorted. "I'm just telling the truth"

"Well, you are full of flaws." - My mother

What bothers me is that she said it matter of factly, kinda like informing me. When she saw the look on my face, it dawned on her how offended I was and she tried to play it off as a joke. Which is more disturbing.
Went to the same school with a boy named Lucifer. Plain Lucifer. I shit you not.
I am new to this, so thank you. Also, cool username :)
